name: Gluetun
description: VPN client in a thin Docker container for multiple providers (Mullvad, ProtonVPN, NordVPN, ExpressVPN and more) over WireGuard or OpenVPN. Includes a built-in kill switch and firewall: containers routed through Gluetun are automatically blocked when the tunnel drops. Ideal for routing torrents and other apps through a stable Mullvad WireGuard tunnel.

variables.name: VPN Provider
variables.description: VPN service provider. Supported: mullvad, protonvpn, nordvpn, expressvpn, private internet access, surfshark and more.

variables.name: WireGuard Private Key
variables.description: Your WireGuard private key (base64). Generate a Mullvad WireGuard config file and use its PrivateKey value. Same for all Mullvad servers.

variables.name: WireGuard Addresses
variables.description: Your WireGuard IP address in CIDR format (e.g. 10.64.222.21/32). Use the IPv4 Address from your generated Mullvad config. Same for all Mullvad servers.

variables.name: Server Countries
variables.description: Comma-separated list of countries to randomly connect to.

variables.name: Server Cities
variables.description: Comma-separated list of cities to randomly connect to. Gluetun picks one at every container start.

devices.name: TUN Device
devices.description: TUN device required for the VPN tunnel. Requires the NET_ADMIN capability (already added via extra_parameters).
